author: FineEnvs
description:
📊 SmolDataEnvs: Harbor (train)
	






5.5K+ RL tasks for hill-climbing small models in code and data science.





A 2B model on these tasks. Left: what it optimises. Right: 144 held-out tasks it never trains on.
Two runs over the same 5,000 tasks: shuffled against a curriculum ordered easiest to hardest.



The training suite: 5,000 hands-on data-analysis tasks. Each one drops an agent into a sandbox with a
real dataset and a question, and asks it to explore the data… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/FineEnvs/SmolDataEnvs-harbor-train.
